_doc: Edit holds (PLAYBOOK §10.4, §12): seconds of picture time after a sentence, matched by its words. Holds over 0.8 s only at act turns and signature beats. The Gemini review (checked 16 NOV 2026) asked for beats after the names and after 'Definitely Stockton'. tail = the outro. Clips (owner, 16 NOV 2026): the witness's own voice from the USCG hearing video replaces our reading of the same quote; in/out found by Whisper word times and cut at the quietest 10 ms in the gap, each trim re-transcribed (assets/titan/hearing/cuts.json); captions are the official transcript CG 112 verbatim, never the auto-captions.

holds.after: Stockton Rush, Paul-Henri Nargeolet, Shahzada Dawood, Suleman Dawood and
holds.why: the five names, said once; dark frame holds (Gemini check #3: 0.70 s was too brisk)

holds.after: So where did the margin of error run out?
And when did the hull start to go?
holds.why: act I to II turn; bed out on the question

holds.after: It was never tested to failure.
holds.why: signature 1 lands: the cylinder's own line never draws

holds.after: No model had ever been built this hull's way,
holds.why: act II to III turn; new exhibit, hard cut

holds.after: Its dives were numbered fifty to eighty-eight.
holds.why: the ledger opens on hull 2; 'Now, dive eighty.'

holds.after: So here is the same data, against depth.
holds.why: signature 2: the axis turns TIME to DEPTH, no narration over the turn

holds.after: Same gauge, same hull, same sea.
The N - T - S - B's finding: because its analysis was flawed,
holds.why: finding 6 on the page; the winter follows

holds.after: The N - T - S - B found that voluntary guidance and the rules
holds.why: act III to IV turn; mid-roll pause

holds.after: Then one line that stops, about five hundred metres short.
holds.why: signature 3: the ledger line ends; room tone

holds.after: Eleven months later, on its first deep dive since, five people were aboard.

holds.why: closing names, unhurried (Gemini check #4: 0.4-0.5 s gaps)

open_loop.promise: After the implosion, the N - T - S - B, America's accident investigator,
open_loop.reveal: So here is the same data, against depth.

replace: In his words: it's not a great test.
caption: But it's not — you know, it's not a great test
clips.credit: U.S. COAST GUARD · MARINE BOARD OF INVESTIGATION HEARING · 23 SEP 2024
clips.why: his own verdict on the inspection

replace: He was asked who made the decision
caption: Q. So who made the decision to continue to resume diving operations after the report of the loud bang?
A. Definitely Stockton.
clips.credit: U.S. COAST GUARD · MARINE BOARD OF INVESTIGATION HEARING · 23 SEP 2024
clips.why: signature: the question and the two words in the room; the transcript page holds 1 s after (was the hold after our line)

replace: And he described the plan, in his words
caption: I know I discussed it with Stockton and he — you know, he wanted to continue on,
that I think the plan was at that time to "well, let's dive again and see what happens" on 81, on the next dives
clips.credit: U.S. COAST GUARD · MARINE BOARD OF INVESTIGATION HEARING · 23 SEP 2024

replace: Brooks testified that what he looked for in the strain was linearity
caption: So what I looked for in strain data was the linearity with depth,
that if it went nonlinear with the depth profile, that that was something to be concerned about.
clips.credit: U.S. COAST GUARD · MARINE BOARD OF INVESTIGATION HEARING · 23 SEP 2024
clips.why: the payoff's set-up: the right test, named by the man who read the data

replace: But OceanGate's plots put strain and depth side by side
caption: OceanGate's strain data was typically and perhaps always plotted as a function of time.
clips.credit: U.S. COAST GUARD · MARINE BOARD OF INVESTIGATION HEARING · 25 SEP 2024
clips.why: the N-T-S-B's own witness says how OceanGate plotted it; the depth re-plot follows as the NTSB's method

replace: They were told the cost of shipping it back was prohibitive.
caption: And we were told it was a cost issue, you know, that the cost of shipping it back was prohibitive
clips.credit: U.S. COAST GUARD · MARINE BOARD OF INVESTIGATION HEARING · 23 SEP 2024
clips.why: ends before "they were low on money" (his characterisation; the NTSB makes no finding on money)

replace: In his words: I felt that the safety
caption: I felt that the safety was just being compromised way too much. At least for myself.
clips.credit: U.S. COAST GUARD · MARINE BOARD OF INVESTIGATION HEARING · 23 SEP 2024
clips.why: why he left, in his voice
